pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


When you are new to the faith, you can feel like you are late to the party. You look around and everyone else seems to know the Bible. They know the stories. They know the names. They know the verses. You are just starting. You feel like you missed something.


Here is what you might have missed. God has always been with His people. From the very first page of the Bible. He was never far. He was never absent. He was always there. He was the secret visitor.


He walked in the garden. He sat in the tent. He stood in the fire. He spoke in the whisper. He wrestled in the dirt. He appeared in the bush. He was there. All along. He was with His people. And He is with you.


This book is for you. You are new to the faith. You are building your foundation. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at 30 moments where God was with His people in the Old Testament. Real moments. Real people. Real presence. And we are going to see that the same God is with you.


You do not need to feel behind. You are not late. You are exactly where God wants you. And He has been with you all along. He is the secret visitor. And He is here.



The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will have a new confidence in your faith. You will see that God has always been with His people. You will see that He is not a distant God. He is a present God. He is the God who is with us.


You will also have a new comfort. Because if God was with His people then, He is with you now. He has not changed. He is the same yesterday, today, and forever. And He is with you.


You will also have a new love for your Bible. Because you will see that it is not just a book of stories. It is a book about a God who is with us. From beginning to end.

pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth." - Genesis 1:1 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Before anything else. Before the stars. Before the earth. Before you. God was there. He was not created. He was not born. He was there. He is the beginning. And He is with you from the beginning. This is the secret visitor. He was there before anything was made.


The Fulfillment


"In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. He was with God in the beginning." - John 1:1-2


The Word was there. The Word is Jesus. He was in the beginning. He was with God. He was God. He is the one who was there. He is the secret visitor. And He is the one who is with you now.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like you are starting late. You might feel like you missed the beginning. But the story of creation tells a different story. God was there in the beginning. And He has been with His people ever since. He is the secret visitor. He has been with you all along. Even before you knew Him.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing that makes you feel like you are late to the party. Then write this: "God was there in the beginning. He has been with me all along."


The Prayer


God, thank you for being there in the beginning. Thank you for being with me all along. I am not late. I am right on time. You are the secret visitor. And you are with me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 1: He Was There in the Beginning

pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the LORD God as he was walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and they hid from the LORD God among the trees of the garden." - Genesis 3:8 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God was walking in the garden. In the cool of the day. Adam and Eve heard Him. They hid. But He was there. He was with them. He was the secret visitor. He was walking. He was looking. He was present.


The Fulfillment


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


The one who walked in the garden is the one who came to earth. The secret visitor is Jesus. He was there. He is here. He is with you.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like God is far away. But the garden tells a different story. God was walking with His people. He was with them. He is with you. He is the secret visitor. He has been with you all along. Even when you did not know it.


Faith Builder


Take a short walk today. As you walk, imagine Jesus walking with you. Talk to Him. Tell Him about your day.


The Prayer


God, thank you for walking with me. Thank you for being with me. I am not alone. You are the secret visitor. And you are here. Amen.
pages.title: Day 2: He Was There in the Garden

pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Look! I see four men walking around in the fire, unbound and unharmed, and the fourth looks like a son of the gods." - Daniel 3:25 (Written around 530 B.C.)


Three men were thrown into a furnace. The king looked in and saw four men. Walking. In the fire. The fourth looked like a god. God was there. In the fire. With His people. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us always. Not to keep us out of the fire. To be in it. The fourth man in the fire is a picture of Jesus. He is the secret visitor. He is with you in the fire.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a fire right now. You might feel like the flames are too hot. But the story of the furnace tells a different story. God is in the fire with you. He is the secret visitor. He is walking with you. You are not alone.


Faith Builder


Write down the fire you are in right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is in the fire with me. I am not alone."


The Prayer


Jesus, you are in the fire with me. Thank you for walking with me. Thank you for being the secret visitor. I am not alone. Amen.
pages.title: Day 3: He Was There in the Fire

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he hurried from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground." - Genesis 18:2 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Three strangers came to Abraham's tent. One of them was God. He sat at the table. He ate. He talked. He stayed. God was there. At the table. With His people. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with that person, and they with me." - Revelation 3:20


Jesus wants to eat with you. He wants to sit at your table. He is the secret visitor. He is knocking. He is waiting. He wants to be with you.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like God is not interested in your daily life. But the tent meal tells a different story. God wants to be with you. He wants to sit at your table. He is the secret visitor. He is with you. Even in the ordinary.


Faith Builder


Set aside a few minutes today to sit quietly with God. Imagine Him at your table. Talk to Him. Let Him be close.


The Prayer


Jesus, come to my table. Come and sit with me. I want you to be part of my everyday life. Stay with me. Eat with me. Be with me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 4: He Was There at the Table

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD found Hagar near a spring in the desert... She gave this name to the LORD who spoke to her: 'You are the God who sees me.'" - Genesis 16:7, 13 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Hagar was a servant. She was running away. She was pregnant. She was alone. She was in the desert. And God was there. He saw her. He spoke to her. He was the secret visitor. He was with her when she was alone.


The Fulfillment


"But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us." - Romans 5:8


God was there. He saw Hagar. He sees you. He is the secret visitor. He is with you when you are alone. He is with you when you feel invisible. He is with you.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel alone right now. You might feel like nobody sees you. But the story of Hagar tells a different story. God sees you. He is with you. He is the secret visitor. He is with you when you are alone. You are not invisible to Him.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing that makes you feel alone. Then write this: "The God who sees me is with me. He is the secret visitor."


The Prayer


God, you see me. You see my desert. You see my pain. Thank you for being with me. Thank you for seeing me. I am not alone. You are the secret visitor. Amen.
pages.title: Day 5: He Was There When You Were Alone

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"So Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him till daybreak... Then the man said, 'Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome.'" - Genesis 32:24, 28 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Jacob was alone. He was scared. And a man came. And they wrestled. All night. And Jacob would not let go. The man was God. God was there. When Jacob was scared. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"But we see Jesus, who was made lower than the angels for a little while, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death." - Hebrews 2:9


Jacob wrestled a man. The man was God. God let Himself be grabbed. God was there when Jacob was scared. He is there when you are scared. He is the secret visitor. He is with you.


Why It Matters For You


You might be scared right now. You might be facing something that feels too big. But the story of Jacob tells a different story. God is with you when you are scared. He is the secret visitor. He lets Himself be grabbed. He is with you.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you are scared of right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me when I am scared. I can hold on to Him."


The Prayer


God, I am scared. I am holding on to you. I am not letting go. You are the secret visitor. You are with me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 6: He Was There When You Were Scared

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"After the earthquake came a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a gentle whisper." - 1 Kings 19:12 (Written around 900 B.C.)


Elijah was scared. He was depressed. He wanted to die. And God was there. Not in the wind. Not in the earthquake. Not in the fire. In a gentle whisper. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


God was there in a whisper. He was there in a baby. He is the secret visitor. He is in the quiet. He is in the small. He is with you.


Why It Matters For You


You might be looking for God in the big things. But He is in the quiet. He is in the whisper. He is the secret visitor. He is with you. Be still. Hear Him.


Faith Builder


Find a quiet place today. No music. No phone. Just you and God. Sit for five minutes in the silence. Listen.


The Prayer


God, help me to hear the whisper. You are the secret visitor. You are in the quiet. Speak to me in the silence. I am listening. Amen.
pages.title: Day 7: He Was There in the Whisper

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the LORD spoke to Job out of the storm." - Job 38:1 (Written around 2000 B.C.)


Job lost everything. He was in pain. He asked God questions. And God was there. In the storm. In the whirlwind. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down and it was completely calm." - Mark 4:39


Jesus spoke to a storm. He calmed the wind. He calmed the waves. God was there in the storm. He is the secret visitor. He is with you in your storm.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a storm right now. You might feel like the waves are too high. But the story of Job tells a different story. God is there in the storm. He is the secret visitor. He is with you.


Faith Builder


Write down the storm you are in right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is in the storm with me. I am not alone."


The Prayer


God, I am in a storm. But you are here. You are the secret visitor. You are with me. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 8: He Was There in the Storm

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Mount Sinai was covered with smoke, because the LORD descended on it in fire. The smoke billowed up from it like smoke from a furnace, and the whole mountain trembled violently." - Exodus 19:18 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The people were at the bottom of the mountain. The mountain was on fire. Smoke was rising. The ground was shaking. A voice was speaking. God was there. On the mountain. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire... But you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God." - Hebrews 12:18, 22


The mountain was terrifying. But we have not come to that mountain. We have come to a better one. Jesus opened a different way. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He brings us close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like God is far away. But the story of the mountain tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He brings you close. You do not have to stand far away anymore.


Faith Builder


Write down one way you feel far from God. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me. He brings me close."


The Prayer


God, you are the secret visitor. You are with me. Thank you for bringing me close. I am not far. You are here. Amen.
pages.title: Day 9: He Was There on the Mountain

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle. Moses could not enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle." - Exodus 40:34-35 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The cloud came down. It covered the tent. The glory filled the tabernacle. God was there. In the cloud. In the glory. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


The glory cloud came down on a tent. Jesus came down in flesh. He is the secret visitor. He is the glory. He is with you.


Why It Matters For You


You might want to experience God's presence. But the story of the cloud tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He fills. He comes near. He is with you.


Faith Builder


Set aside a few quiet minutes today. Ask God to fill you with His presence. Then sit still and let Him be near.


The Prayer


God, you are the secret visitor. Fill me with your presence. I want to know your glory. Fill me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 10: He Was There in the Cloud

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah... and said, 'The LORD is with you, mighty warrior.'" - Judges 6:11-12 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


Gideon was hiding. He was scared. He was the least important person in his family. And God was there. He called him a mighty warrior. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong." - 1 Corinthians 1:27


God chooses the weak. He chose Gideon. He is the secret visitor. He is with you when you are weak. He calls you a warrior.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel weak right now. You might feel like the least. But the story of Gideon tells a different story. God is with you when you are weak. He is the secret visitor. He calls you a warrior.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you feel too weak for. Then write this next to it: "The secret visitor is with me when I am weak. He calls me a mighty warrior."


The Prayer


God, I feel weak. But you are with me. You are the secret visitor. You call me a mighty warrior. Make me brave. Amen.
pages.title: Day 11: He Was There When You Were Weak

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD appeared to her and said, 'You are barren and childless, but you are going to become pregnant and give birth to a son.'" - Judges 13:3 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


A woman could not have children. She was barren. And God was there. He told her she would have a son. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"But the angel said to her, 'Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God. You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him Jesus.'" - Luke 1:30-31


The angel came to Mary. He promised a son. The son was Jesus. God was there. He is the secret visitor. He gives the impossible.


Why It Matters For You


You might have a barren place. A place where nothing grows. But the story of the barren woman tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He gives the impossible.


Faith Builder


Write down your barren place. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me in my barren place. He gives the impossible."


The Prayer


God, I have a barren place. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Give me the impossible. Give me a future. Amen.
pages.title: Day 12: He Was There When You Were Barren

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"But the angel said to him, 'Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to call him John.'" - Luke 1:13 (Written around 5 B.C.)


Zechariah was a priest. He was old. They had no children. They had prayed for years. And God was there. He told him his prayer had been heard. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for him." - Luke 1:76


John was the forerunner. He prepared the way. God was there when Zechariah prayed. He is the secret visitor. He hears. He answers.


Why It Matters For You


You might have given up on a prayer. But the story of Zechariah tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He hears. He answers. He is with you.


Faith Builder


Write down one prayer you have given up on. Then pray it again today. Just once. Say it out loud.


The Prayer


God, I have given up on some prayers. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. You hear. You answer. Thank you. I am praying again. Amen.
pages.title: Day 13: He Was There When You Prayed

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"But after he had considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, 'Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife, because what is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.'" - Matthew 1:20 (Written around 5 B.C.)


Joseph was confused. He was scared. He was unsure. And God was there. In a dream. He spoke. He calmed. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins." - Matthew 1:21


The name is Jesus. He saves. God was there to Joseph. He is the secret visitor. He is with you. He speaks. He calms. He saves.


Why It Matters For You


You might be confused right now. But the story of Joseph tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He speaks. He guides. He calms.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you are confused about right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me when I am confused. He will guide me."


The Prayer


God, I am confused. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Speak. Guide me. Calm me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 14: He Was There When You Were Confused

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"But the angel said to them, 'Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people. Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord.'" - Luke 2:10-11 (Written around 5 B.C.)


Shepherds were in the fields. The lowest of the low. The ones nobody noticed. And God was there. He brought them good news. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord." - Luke 2:11


The Savior is born. The Messiah is here. God was there to the shepherds. He is the secret visitor. He is with you when you are overlooked.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel overlooked. But the story of the shepherds tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He comes to you. You are not forgotten.


Faith Builder


Write down one way you feel overlooked. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me when I am overlooked. He comes to me."


The Prayer


God, I feel overlooked. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Thank you for coming to me. I am not forgotten. Amen.
pages.title: Day 15: He Was There When You Were Overlooked

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Now the LORD provided a huge fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights." - Jonah 1:17 (Written around 780 B.C.)


Jonah ran from God. He was thrown into the sea. A fish swallowed him. For three days and three nights, he was in the belly of the fish. In the dark. And God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a huge fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth." - Matthew 12:40


Jesus said the fish was Him. He said the belly was the grave. On the third day, He came out. God is there in the dark. He is the secret visitor. He brings you out.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in the dark right now. But the story of Jonah tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He hears. He answers. He brings you out.


Faith Builder


Write down the dark place you are in right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is in the dark with me. He brings me out."


The Prayer


God, I am in the dark. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Hear me. Answer me. Bring me out. Amen.
pages.title: Day 16: He Was There in the Dark

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD came back a second time and touched him and said, 'Get up and eat, for the journey is too much for you.'" - 1 Kings 19:7 (Written around 900 B.C.)


Elijah was exhausted. He was in the wilderness. He wanted to die. And God was there. He touched him. He fed him. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest." - Matthew 11:28


Jesus gives rest. He strengthens. He feeds. God is there when you are exhausted. He is the secret visitor. He gives you rest.


Why It Matters For You


You might be exhausted right now. But the story of Elijah tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He touches you. He feeds you. He lifts you up.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing that is exhausting you right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me when I am exhausted. He gives me rest."


The Prayer


God, I am exhausted. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Touch me. Feed me. Lift me up. Give me rest. Amen.
pages.title: Day 17: He Was There When You Were Exhausted

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the LORD said to Moses, 'See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.'" - Exodus 23:20 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God sent an angel to guard His people. To lead them. To protect them. God was there. He was the secret visitor. He opens doors. He breaks chains.


The Fulfillment


"Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up. 'Quick, get up!' he said, and the chains fell off Peter's wrists." - Acts 12:7


An angel appeared to Peter. Chains fell off. The gates opened. Peter was free. God is there when you are in prison. He is the secret visitor. He opens doors. He breaks chains.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a prison right now. But the story of Peter tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He opens doors. He breaks chains. He sets you free.


Faith Builder


Write down the prison you feel trapped in right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me in prison. He opens doors. He breaks chains."


The Prayer


God, I am in a prison. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Set me free. Break the chains. Open the door. Let me walk out. Amen.
pages.title: Day 18: He Was There When You Were in Prison

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord, high and exalted, seated on a throne; and the train of his robe filled the temple." - Isaiah 6:1 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah was in the temple. And he saw something. He saw the Lord. High and lifted up. On a throne. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus' glory and spoke about him." - John 12:41


Isaiah saw Jesus. He saw His glory. He saw His throne. God is there on the throne. He is the secret visitor. He is in control. He is the King.


Why It Matters For You


You might need to see God. You might need to see His glory. Look at Jesus. He is on the throne. He is the secret visitor. He is in control. He is the King. He is with you.


Faith Builder


Take a few minutes today to worship. Say out loud, "Holy, holy, holy. You are on the throne."


The Prayer


Lord, I see you. High and lifted up. Holy. On the throne. You are the secret visitor. I worship you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 19: He Was There on the Throne

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them." - Psalm 34:7 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear Him. He camps around them. He protects them. He delivers them. God is there when you need protection. He is the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways." - Psalm 91:11


God sends angels to guard His people. God is there when you need protection. He is the secret visitor. He guards you. He protects you. He delivers you.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel unprotected. But the psalm tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He encamps around you. He guards you. He delivers you.


Faith Builder


Say this out loud today: "The secret visitor encamps around me. He protects me."


The Prayer


God, thank you for protecting me. Thank you for guarding me. Thank you for delivering me. You are the secret visitor. Amen.
pages.title: Day 20: He Was There When You Needed Protection

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the LORD spoke to Job out of the storm." - Job 38:1 (Written around 2000 B.C.)


Job lost everything. He was in pain. He asked God questions. And God was there. In the storm. God is there in the storm. He is the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down and it was completely calm." - Mark 4:39


Jesus spoke to a storm. He calmed the wind. He calmed the waves. God is there in the storm. He is the secret visitor. He speaks. He calms.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a storm right now. But the story of Job tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He speaks. He calms. He is with you.


Faith Builder


Write down the storm you are in right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is in the storm with me. He speaks. He calms."


The Prayer


God, I am in a storm. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Speak. Calm. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 21: He Was There When You Were in the Storm

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink." - Genesis 21:19 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Hagar was hopeless. She was dying. Her son was dying. She cried. She gave up. And God was there. He opened her eyes. He showed her a well. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"Whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life." - John 4:14


Jesus is the water. He is the well. God is there when you are hopeless. He is the secret visitor. He opens your eyes. He gives you water.


Why It Matters For You


You might be hopeless right now. But the story of Hagar tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He opens your eyes. He gives you water. He gives you life.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing that makes you feel hopeless. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me when I am hopeless. He opens my eyes."


The Prayer


God, I am hopeless. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Open my eyes. Give me water. Give me life. Amen.
pages.title: Day 22: He Was There When You Were Hopeless

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Moses said to the LORD, 'I cannot carry all these people by myself; the burden is too heavy for me.'" - Numbers 11:14 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Moses was tired. The burden was too heavy. And God was there. He helped him. He gave him a helper. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls." - Matthew 11:28-29


Jesus gives rest. He lifts the burden. God is there when you are tired. He is the secret visitor. He gives you rest.


Why It Matters For You


You might be tired right now. The burden might be too heavy. But the story of Moses tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He helps you. He lifts the burden. He gives you rest.


Faith Builder


Write down the burden that feels too heavy right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me when I am tired. He lifts the burden."


The Prayer


God, I am tired. The burden is too heavy. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Help me. Lift the burden. Give me rest. Amen.
pages.title: Day 23: He Was There When You Were Tired

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD answered, 'Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding.'" - Judges 13:18 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


Manoah asked the angel his name. The angel said it was beyond understanding. God was there. He answered. Even when Manoah could not understand. God is there when you are doubting. He is the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed." - John 20:29


Jesus said this to Thomas. Thomas doubted. Jesus showed up. He did not scold Thomas. He showed him His hands. God is there when you are doubting. He is the secret visitor. He shows you Himself.


Why It Matters For You


You might be doubting right now. You might have questions you cannot answer. But the story of Manoah tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He does not scold you. He shows you Himself.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you doubt. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me when I doubt. He shows me Himself."


The Prayer


God, I am doubting. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. You do not scold me. You show me yourself. Help my unbelief. Amen.



Day 25
….

The Prayer (continued)


God, I am doubting. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. You do not scold me. You show me yourself. Help my unbelief. Amen.
pages.title: Day 24: He Was There When You Were Doubting

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to keep it from the Midianites." - Judges 6:11 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


Gideon was grieving. His people were oppressed. He was hiding. He was afraid. And God was there. He sat down under the oak. He spoke to him. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"He is the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our troubles." - 2 Corinthians 1:3-4


God is the Father of compassion. He comforts. God is there when you are grieving. He is the secret visitor. He sits with you. He speaks to you. He comforts you.


Why It Matters For You


You might be grieving right now. You might have lost something. You might have lost someone. But the story of Gideon tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He sits with you. He speaks to you. He comforts you.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you are grieving right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me when I am grieving. He comforts me."


The Prayer


God, I am grieving. I am hurting. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Sit with me. Comfort me. I need your comfort. Amen.
pages.title: Day 26: He Was There When You Were Grieving

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The LORD God said, 'It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him.'" - Genesis 2:18 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God saw that Adam was alone. And He said it was not good. He made a helper for him. God cares about loneliness. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us always. God is there when you are lonely. He is the secret visitor. He is with you. He is not far.


Why It Matters For You


You might be lonely right now. You might feel isolated. But the story of Adam tells a different story. God cares about loneliness. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He is with you. You are not alone.


Faith Builder


Write down one way you feel lonely right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor is with me when I am lonely. I am not alone."


The Prayer


God, I am lonely. I feel isolated. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Be with me. I am not alone. Amen.
pages.title: Day 27: He Was There When You Were Lonely

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"But while Joseph was there in the prison, the LORD was with him; he showed him kindness and granted him favor in the eyes of the prison warden." - Genesis 39:20-21 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Joseph was in prison. He was forgotten. He was alone. But God was there. The Lord was with him. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us always. God is there when you are forgotten. He is the secret visitor. He has not forgotten you. He is with you.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel forgotten right now. You might feel like nobody remembers you. But the story of Joseph tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. He has not forgotten you. He is with you.


Faith Builder


Write down one way you feel forgotten right now. Then write this: "The secret visitor has not forgotten me. He is with me."


The Prayer


God, I feel forgotten. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. You have not forgotten me. Thank you. I am not alone. Amen.
pages.title: Day 28: He Was There When You Were Forgotten

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"But the LORD said to Gideon, 'You have too many men. I cannot deliver Midian into their hands, or Israel would boast against me, "My own strength has saved me."'" - Judges 7:2 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


Gideon had a big army. But God said it was too many. God wanted to show His power. He wanted to show His strength. God was there. He was the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'" - 2 Corinthians 12:9


God's power is made perfect in weakness. God is there when you are weak. He is the secret visitor. He shows His strength. He shows His power.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel weak right now. You might feel like you cannot do it. But the story of Gideon tells a different story. God is there. He is the secret visitor. His power is made perfect in your weakness. He will show His strength through you.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you feel too weak for. Then write this: "God's power is made perfect in my weakness. He is the secret visitor."


The Prayer


God, I feel weak. But you are there. You are the secret visitor. Your power is made perfect in my weakness. Show your strength through me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 29: He Was There When You Were Weak

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace." - Isaiah 9:6 (Written around 700 B.C.)


A child. A son. Mighty God. Everlasting Father. Prince of Peace. This is the promise. This is the appearance. This is the one who was always with His people. The child is God. The son is eternal. The baby is the Creator. This is the one who was always there. He is the secret visitor.


The Fulfillment


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


The Word became flesh. The secret visitor became a person. The shadow became substance. The picture became reality. The garden became a body. The fire became a friend. The whisper became a brother. The star became the King. The tomb became the risen Lord. The secret visitor is Jesus. And He is here. He is with you. Always.


Why It Matters For You


You have been learning about the secret visitor for 30 days. But here is the beautiful truth. He is not just a figure from long ago. He is with you right now. He was with His people in the garden. He was with them at the table. He was with them in the fire. He was with them in the whisper. And He is with you. He has always been with you. He is the secret visitor. And He is here.


Faith Builder


Take a moment today to thank God for being with you. Write down one way you have felt Him near during this 30 day journey.


The Prayer


Jesus, thank you for being the secret visitor. Thank you for being with me all along. Thank you for the garden. Thank you for the table. Thank you for the fire. Thank you for the whisper. Thank you for being with me in every season. I know you are here. I know you have always been with me. I love you. I trust you. Amen.



END MATTER


The 30-Day With You Challenge


You have journeyed through 30 moments where God was with His people. Now what? I challenge you to read the Gospel of Matthew. It is 28 chapters. It is the perfect follow-up. It shows you the secret visitor in the flesh. It shows you Jesus, the one who is always with us. As you read, look for the ways Jesus is with people. Look for the ways He comes near. And then ask yourself, "Do I know that He is with me?" He is. He has always been with you. He is with you now.


A Note on Faith


The appearances are evidence. They are evidence of a God who is with His people. They are evidence of a God who is not distant. They are evidence of a God who has always been there. But evidence does not save you. The appearances point to a person. The appearances point to Jesus. You can study the appearances and still miss the one who is with you. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The secret visitor is at the door. The door is open. It is your choice. He is with you. Will you open?


About the Author


Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the hidden wisdom of the Bible. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.


Coming Next: The Seeker Edition


If you enjoyed this journey, the next book in the series goes deeper. The Seeker Edition takes the same 30 appearances and shows you the mystery and wonder of the God who shows up. It is for the person who wants to go further.
